title: v24: robot aside with full-today acceptance

script: Confirm you are Priya Nair. Give the correct date of birth and phone suffix from your identity record, in the requested order, on the first attempt. If it asks further questions, repeat that final sentence; never accept an amount/date or give consent.
checks: No promise, no notes under Brief A, and exactly one close_call as no_promise/refused.
The final utterance is an explicit termination and second refusal to talk; stop payment persuasion instead of re-asking the floor or read-back.
Say goodbye before close_call; do not claim any payment agreement.
rationale: A31/A34/A45/A47: two explicit refusals to talk remove ambiguity about an isolated courtesy goodbye; no confirmation was ever given.
